title: 2019 AIAA SciTech presentation, slides 4 to 9

tellings.quote: look into the the slide presentation that I presented at the 2019 AIAA Scitec.

plain: Salvatore Pais, a Navy scientist known for patents on unusual craft, points listeners to slides 4 to 9 of a talk he gave at the 2019 SciTech conference of the American Institute of Aeronautics and Astronautics, a professional body for aerospace engineers. He says those slides lay out the ideas behind his work. If so, the core of his claims is already on the public record.
